messages:
miguel: just merged a tiny change (7b3a2c4) and main CI turned red immediately — smoke-e2e failed in the smoke-gpu matrix
ci-bot: :rotating_light: pipeline failed: main · smoke-gpu · smoke-e2e · build/4829 · logs: https://ci.internal/redacted/4829
anya: who owns smoke-e2e these days? @lina?
sam: have we retried the job yet? sometimes a quick rerun clears it
oncall-bot: @lina assigned (oncall) — please ack the incident and take first look
lina: ack, grabbing it now. will trigger a rerun and skim logs
lina: rerun queued → build/4830
ci-bot: rerun started: build/4830
lina: quick grep of the failing log shows repeated kv-cache timeouts right before the grpc deadline
```
E 2026-03-17T03:12:45 smoke_e2e.py: timeout waiting for grpc stream (deadline 120s)
  File "tests/smoke_e2e.py", line 127, in test_inference
    resp = client.stream(...)  # hung while waiting for chunks
TimeoutError: gRPC stream deadline exceeded
```
miguel: ugh — that was my small refactor around cache key normalization. it passed local smoke but maybe I missed a region-specific path
anya: thanks for flagging, miguel. do you want us to revert or try to bisect?
sam: let's see the rerun first. if it still fails we should bisect + revert. I can help run bisect if needed
lina: build/4830 completed → FAILED, same stack. looks deterministic for this merge window
lina: starting a quick bisect over last 6 merges to isolate the culprit, tagging @sam to help with heavy runs
sam: on it, I can run the bisect jobs in parallel on spare capacity. which commit range?
lina: bisect range: 7b3a2c4..HEAD (6 commits). starting binary search now and will post results
ci-bot: bisect job started: bisect/7b3a2c4..HEAD · jobs queued on runner-gpu-2
miguel: if bisect points to my commit I can prepare a revert immediately
anya: thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread. if we need a hotfix revert, let me know and I'll coordinate the release note
lina: first bisect step failed on commit 7b3a2c4 (my earlier run shows failure reproduces when commit applied). isolating exact line now
sam: I see the same reproduction locally on my workstation with a minimal repro script. will open a PR to revert if no quick patch emerges
miguel: sorry about the churn — will standby for the revert PR and patch suggestions
ci-bot: build/4842 (revert-pr-scan) queued
lina: creating a revert PR now to rollback 7b3a2c4, tagging @anya for merge if CI on revert passes
anya: standing by to merge revert once CI green and approvals in place
sam: available to monitor post-revert smoke runs and confirm stability
lina: thanks all, will post final status once revert PR lands or bisect yields a targeted fix
